new_assertions.body: Absolute owner labels are not load-bearing in the declared common scalar carrier: D_SYMMETRIC_MARGINALS is exact on all three hard carriers.
Complete owner merging is too coarse only on 4x5-k4, where it leaves eight scalar contradictions; therefore the load-bearing residue is owner-channel asymmetry rather than owner identity itself.

The selected owner quotient retains only D totals and absolute per-sign owner imbalance. Which absolute owner carries the imbalance and within-channel plus/minus pairing are unnecessary in the frozen common realization.
On 4x5-k4 the selected owner quotient reduces the roleless/depthless signed-parity image from rank 262 to 254 while preserving the two-dimensional scalar image.

The current common pair signature is six nonnegative structural buckets C+,C-,D+,D-,A+,A-, where A+/A- are absolute owner-channel imbalances. The next lawful compression should act only on these bucket values.
Presence/parity/ZOE/saturation transforms of the six bucket counts can now be frozen without referring to descriptor identity, role index, depth index, or absolute owner label.
EW-RS-059 remains sealed because EW-RS-074 still supplies a structural carrier rather than a closed scalar syndrome.
